title: Protein Expression of Hard-to-Propose Proteins in E. coli Cytoplasm
author: Cristina Hernandez Rollan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfbwjipe

steps.title: Prepare overnight culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a fresh colony of BL21 (DE3) strain transformed with the expression vector into LB medium supplemented with relevant antibiotics.

substeps.instruction: Grow the culture overnight at 37 °C with 250 RPM shaking.
Ensure the overnight culture volume is at least 1/100 of the intended expression culture volume.

steps.title: Inoculate expression culture
steps.instruction: Dilute the overnight culture 1:100 into fresh LB supplemented with relevant antibiotics.

substeps.instruction: Grow the culture at 37 °C with 250 RPM shaking until an OD 600 reaches 0.5 - 0.6.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Induce expression by adding IPTG to a final concentration of 1 millimolar (mM).

steps.title: Incubate induced culture
steps.instruction: Move the culture into an incubator set to 18 °C with 180 RPM shaking.

substeps.instruction: Allow the culture to reach OD 600 = 0.8 - 1.0.
Grow the culture for 20:00:00 at 18 °C with 180 RPM shaking (note: temperature can be lowered further for slower induction to increase soluble product).

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Collect induced samples by centrifugation at 8000 x g for 20 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Freeze pellets at -80 °C or -20 °C if not proceeding immediately to extraction.

steps.title: Lyse cells and store extracts
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells using a lysis protocol or a commercially available kit.

substeps.instruction: Keep extractions on ice during work.
